name: @pipeworx/mcp-crontab

tools.name: describe_cron
tools.description: Parse and validate a cron expression (5 fields or an @alias) and describe it in plain English. Returns the parsed fields and whether it is valid.

tools.name: next_runs
tools.description: Compute the next N run times (UTC ISO-8601) for a cron expression. Optionally start from a given time.

count.description: How many upcoming runs to return (1-50, default 5).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-crontab forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the crontab pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
